format: RGBA16Float (uint16 little-endian bit patterns), row-major, index = (px + py*face_size)*4 + channel
face_convention: matches THREE.CubeTexture images order; texel (px,py) -> u,v=((idx+0.5)/size)*2-1 in [-1,1]; row 0 = v=-1 (flipY=false, matches app/src/field/bakeCube.ts)

channels.R: built-up fraction, raw (0..1, no log encoding -- values are naturally bounded and mostly near 0)
channels.A: validity: always 1.0 -- texels beyond GHSL's actual polar coverage are treated as genuinely 0 built-up (real: no cities in Antarctica), not missing data

coverage.note: GHSL clips a bit short of the poles (tiepoint lat0=89.0996, not 90.0); texels beyond are set to u=0, not extrapolated
